title: Sebastian and the Choir
author: Freya Amberdale
blurb: Ulyana Thornbury, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
